text:
claire: Heads-up — noticed the internal KB shortlink in the onboarding runbook now returns 410 after the CDN redirect change. steps 2-4 have an inline shortlink that 404s. https://redwood.internal/kb/onboarding -> 410

sam: ugh, thanks for the catch. pinging @mike since he touched the onboarding flow last sprint. can someone own a tiny PR? :wave:

mike: I can take this later today. is it just one URL or also an anchor/image?

claire: just the shortlink in the markdown paragraph (step 3). image assets look fine. note the anchor id changed — used to be `#get-started`, now `#start`.

sam: ok. easiest fix is to update the md to the new canonical URL+anchor. I'll open a quick PR with a sed replace and preview.

mike: please add a short description and link the failing scanner result in the PR. I'll review. tag @elaine for localization sanity.

elaine: FYI translations might need a tiny backport if the anchor rename is referenced in localized copies. happy to scan after PR lands.

docs-bot: automated-link-scan: flagged 1 additional shortlink with potential rotation in /guides/kv-cache — adding to the docs sweep queue.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 — single-line patch, preview attached. Patch uses: ```git apply -p0 <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/onboarding.md
@@
- See the quickstart at [Onboarding guide](https://short.redwood/kb/onboarding#get-started)
+ See the quickstart at [Onboarding guide](https://redwood.internal/kb/onboarding#start)
*** End Patch
PATCH
```

mike: quick look — LGTM. CI note: check the preview rendering for the localized includes. I'll merge after green CI.

claire: added a short changelog line in the PR. also left a TODO comment for the kv-cache flagged by docs-bot. thanks y'all.

elaine: flagged to localization queue. will confirm if any locales reference the old anchor and patch shortly.

sam: merged PR #4521 into main. docs deploy should pick it up.

deploy-bot: docs-deploy: started publish job 887 for main -> production.

claire: verified production link is live and anchor navigates correctly :tada: Thanks for the fast turnaround.

mike: nice, closing out on our side. will follow up if localization needs extra work.

sam: marking this thread as resolved in the sprint board.
